reasons: Section 18.1 matches the preferred position limits exactly (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' comp as required by law) for the term plus one year, and 18.2 adds certificates on request, insurer quality, primacy and non-limitation of liability — so the clause meets, and in places exceeds, the preferred position.

Compliant status is correctly claimed: no redline and no counterparty comment were proposed, which is the expected output for a clause that fully satisfies the playbook, and the deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present.
Rationale is accurate and does not overstate: it correctly notes employer's liability USD 1M as an extra beyond the playbook ask and confirms nothing in the clause disadvantages the Customer.
